messages:
elaine: FYI I opened a docs PR for the generate endpoint — examples show the `files` param as null in one sample and as [] in another; it's confusing for integrators. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1428 :thinking_face:
sam: I saw that, thanks. Which sample exactly? I can patch the examples, but we should decide canonical representation (null vs []).
elaine: It's in /api-reference/generate.md under examples. The request schema currently marks `files` as nullable array — runtime treats omitted and [] mostly the same, but our SDKs are inconsistent. We should standardize on `[]` to avoid languages that map null differently.
mike: quick runtime note: server accepts omitted, null, or [] but some proxies and middlewares canonicalize null to absent. SDKs that marshal nil vs [] matter.
jen: docs perspective — let's update examples to use `[]` and add a short paragraph 'when to send an empty array vs omitting the field' and a migration note for SDKs.
sam: I'll update the examples and add the migration blurb. Also need to change the Ruby SDK snippet — it currently uses `nil` for files.
devex-bot: @sam flagged for codegen: prefer empty arrays for optional repeated fields when example shows [] (task #DEVEX-289).
sam: pushed a small patch to the PR swapping null -> [] in examples and adding a 2-sentence note. Diff: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1428/files
ellen: (oops meant jen) can we include an explicit cURL sample too? Some customers copy that.
jen: yes, include cURL and JS snippets. Also add a tiny 'why this change' line: 'Some client libraries prefer [] to signal no attachments; this avoids surprise serialization as null.'
mike: Confirmed with infra — no behaviour change server-side, but recommend [] to keep proxies happy. Also add a test-case to regen harness to ensure SDKs don't produce null by default.
sam: Updated PR with cURL and JS snippets and Ruby fix. cURL example:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model":"redwood/generate-2","input":"summarize","files":[]}'
```
And JSON example to use in docs:
```json
{
  "model": "redwood/generate-2",
  "input": "summarize this long doc",
  "files": []
}
```
sam: Ruby snippet I updated:
```ruby
client.generate(model: "redwood/generate-2", input: "summarize", files: [])
```
docs-bot: Checklist: examples updated, SDK snippet updated, reviewers needed: @jen @mike
jen: I'll review in a bit. If approved, we should merge and then create a tiny migration note in the release notes/announce channel so customers know to prefer [] in new clients.
mike: I'll add a line in the infra changelog that proxies may drop explicit `null` fields, so recommending [] reduces risk.
sam: merged after jen's quick pass. Sending a follow-up PR to devex to change codegen default behaviour (linked in PR comments).
jen: thanks everyone — nice small cleanup. I'll post a short blurb in #release-notes and link the PR. :thumbsup:
